title: The Moon That Has Artificial Structures Built Inside It
hook: Radar scans of Saturn's moon Iapetus show a geometric grid 10 miles beneath the ice — and NASA won't release the full data.
why_this_can_go_viral: Alien megastructures are a viral goldmine — the specific NASA secrecy angle adds conspiracy fuel.

title: The Secret Radar Array That Tracked an Object Coming From Outside the Galaxy
hook: In 1995, a classified US radar station detected an object entering the Milky Way at 99% the speed of light — it braked.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extragalactic + classified + artificial braking = the perfect conspiracy horror cocktail for viral growth.

title: The Asteroid That Has a Radio Signal Coming From Inside It
hook: The asteroid 16 Psyche is emitting a regular pulse — and it's not from reflection or rotation, it's internal.
why_this_can_go_viral: A metallic asteroid broadcasting a signal is the perfect hook for alien tech speculation — Psyche is already famous.

title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Changed Shape to Avoid Detection
hook: A dark matter halo around a dwarf galaxy appears to have moved when scientists tried to map it — as if it's aware.
why_this_can_go_viral: Personifying dark matter as 'hiding' triggers organic curiosity and conspiracy-level interest in physics.

title: The Comet That Released a Gas That Kills All Life It Touches
hook: Comet 67P contains a cyanide compound so toxic that a single gram could kill every human on Earth — and it passed by us in 2015.
why_this_can_go_viral: A comet that could end all life just by brushing our atmosphere is a visceral, terrifying, and shareable concept.

title: The Extinction Event That Left a Layer of Pure Iridium — Everywhere
hook: There's a global layer of iridium, a metal from space, that marks a mass death — but it appears 200,000 years before the dinosaurs died.
why_this_can_go_viral: A hidden mass death before the famous one messes with established history — comments will explode with theories.

title: The Soviet Space Station That Heard a Child Crying in the Void
hook: Cosmonauts on Salyut 7 reported a sound like a crying child outside the hull — at an altitude where no sound can travel.
why_this_can_go_viral: A crying child in the silent void combines horror with historical conspiracy — perfect for TikTok shock value.

title: The Galaxy Where Stars Are Dying in Perfect Order — Row by Row
hook: A galaxy 300 million light-years away shows stars extinguishing in a sequential wave pattern — as if something is moving through.
why_this_can_go_viral: A galaxy dying in orderly rows suggests an intelligence at work — the perfect alien mystery narrative.

title: The Classified US Program That Built a Camera That Sees Through the Sun
hook: Declassified documents reveal a 1970s project that used neutrino imaging to see objects inside the Sun — and they found something.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that the US government saw something inside the Sun and kept it secret is pure viral bait.

title: The Neutron Star That Emits Light Only When You're Not Looking
hook: A neutron star's pulses stop the moment you point a telescope at it — and resume when you look away.
why_this_can_go_viral: A star that 'knows' it's being watched blurs the line between physics and consciousness — comment debate guaranteed.

title: The Rogue Planet That Has a Surface Temperature of -400°F — But a Hot Core
hook: An orphan planet drifting alone has a frozen surface but a core hotter than Earth's — something is heating it from inside.
why_this_can_go_viral: A planet with no star but internal heat suggests artificial or unknown energy sources — fuels alien tech speculation.

title: The Dark Matter That Created a Tidal Wave of Stars
hook: A river of 4,000 stars is flowing through the Milky Way at 200 km/s — and only dark matter gravity could move them like this.
why_this_can_go_viral: A river of stars pushed by invisible force is poetic and mysterious — visual potential is high for short-form.

title: The Asteroid That Has a 0% Chance of Hitting Earth — But It's Getting Closer
hook: Apophis was ruled safe for 100 years, but new tracking shows its orbit is shifting — and the models won't say why.
why_this_can_go_viral: A 'safe' asteroid secretly getting closer flips the narrative — viewers love 'they lied to us' angles.

title: The Black Hole That Is Spinning at 99.9% the Speed of Light
hook: A black hole in NGC 1365 is spinning so fast that the edge of its event horizon is moving at near light speed — and it's aimed at us.
why_this_can_go_viral: A black hole aimed at Earth spinning near the universal speed limit is a visual and existential blockbuster.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: Alien Life Is Trapped by Gravity
hook: New physics suggests that advanced civilizations could be trapped on their own planets by gravity wells too deep to escape.
why_this_can_go_viral: A non-alien, non-violent explanation for silence that's still terrifying — 'they want to leave but can't' is tragic and shareable.
